# ANALYSIS: STAGE-1 BACKTEST AND VALIDATION PLAN FOR TOP 3 J-DAYS

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are executing the Stage-1 backtest via autoresearch grinder to establish baseline performance, then conducting walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation specifically on the top 3 J-days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to verify edge capture robustness and rule out overfit to these anchor days. This validates whether the engine's edge on J's source-of-truth winners is statistically significant and not driven by isolated outliers.

## Mechanism

1. **Stage-1 backtest via autoresearch grinder**: Run in-sample backtest over maximum available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using baseline engine rules (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON PUTs, ITM-2, −50% premium stop, +50% TP1 at 0.667 qty fraction, chandelier profit-lock, chart-stop primary). Capture per-trade P&L on all days.
2. **Walk-forward OOS validation**: Split data into 5 rolling windows (80% train, 20% test) ensuring each top 3 J-day appears in exactly one OOS window. Compute edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners_in_OOS) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers_in_OOS)) across all OOS windows. Require OOS edge_capture ≥ 771 (50% of max possible 1542).
3. **Real-fills validation on top 3 J-days**: Replay the exact entry/exit logic from Stage-1 using cached real OPRA fills (bid/ask, slippage model) for 4/29, 5/01, 5/04. Compare dollar P&L to Stage-1 simulator results. Require absolute difference < ±20% on each day.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper realizes ~14% of headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure example)
2. **Sample bias:** Using all available history (16 months) for Stage-1 reduces selection bias, but walk-forward OOS uses only 20% of data per window (n≈69 days OOS total). Top 3 J-days represent small sample (3 days); overfit risk mitigated by requiring OOS edge_capture ≥ 771 across all windows.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Will report walk-forward OOS edge_capture result; if not computed yet, marked as NEEDS-OOS
4. **Real-fills:** Will report real-fills vs simulator diff on top 3 J-days; if not performed yet, marked as NEEDS-REAL-FILLS
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Engine loses on a J winner day (e.g., −$342 on 4/29)
   - Max drawdown: Computed from equity curve during OOS windows
   - Blow-up scenario: Engine takes large losses on J loser days (e.g., −$260 on 5/05) while missing winners
6. **Concentration:** Will compute top-5-days % of total P&L from Stage-1 backtest; if top 5 days exceed 50% of P&L, concentration disclosure required

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: All strategy/backtest/gym tests must PASS
- Walk-forward OOS: edge_cascade ≥ 771 and Sharpe ratio ≥ 0.70 across all windows
- Real-fills: Absolute P&L difference < ±20% on each of top 3 J-days
- Anchor no-regression: Edge_capture on J days must not decrease vs baseline
- OP-20 disclosures: All 6 items completed with passing results
